# Serena Cao

AI Product Designer and Design Engineer based in New York, NY.

Serena Cao (Qingyu Cao) is a product designer who codes. She designs UX for AI products and ships the frontends herself in React and Next.js, covering the full path from design system to deployed product. She is currently the founding designer of Kogna, a live AI decision-support platform for executives, now in private beta.

This site is a single-page React app. If you cannot render JavaScript, this file is the reliable summary of the pages listed below.

## Pages

- Home: https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/
- About: https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/about

## Selected work

- Kogna (2026): Led the design system and UI/UX for an AI decision-support platform that turns fragmented business data into real-time strategic intelligence for leaders. https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/project/kogna
- Side Pocket (2026): A global side-income ledger with a tax layer, built at the MONEY TALKS hackathon in New York. Statements from eight platforms land in one ledger, and every number the AI assistant gives links back to the step that produced it. https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/project/side-pocket
- Vhay (2026): Marketplace and UI redesign for Vhay, an on-chain B2B marketplace and trade finance platform live on the XRP Ledger, made at the AI & Fintech XRP Ledger Hackathon in New York. Serena rebuilt the marketplace filters and seller details, and moved the app to a glass shell with design tokens and AA contrast. https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/project/vhay
- GBK Parts (2026): Serena's full-time job. A heavy-duty truck parts supplier that took orders by phone, email and PDF price lists now runs on a self-serve B2B website she designed and built with Claude Code, a dashboard that shows every sales channel on one screen, and AI workflows with written rules for what the agent may do alone and what needs her approval. https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/project/gbkparts
- Spark Up (2026): An AI platform that diagnoses startup readiness, generates personalized business ideas, and validates them through community feedback. https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/project/sparkup
- Petiboxy (2025): A pet rescue ecosystem connecting people with pets in need, supporting rescue organizations, and building a compassionate community. https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/project/petiboxy
- Stumbldoor (2024): A mobile app that rethinks the library experience for people who grew up reading on screens. https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/project/stumbldoor
- Wishflow (2026): A bilingual wish keeper for people who go quiet when an app starts counting streaks. Designed and built solo in Next.js and Supabase. https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/project/wishflow
- world.execute(me); (2026): An AIMV, a 3 minute 32 second fan film for Mili's song generated entirely by code: every frame is a pure function of time, cut on the beat, built from twelve simulations that are actually running. https://portfolio.qingyucao.com/project/worldexecute
